svg.title: Untracked star paths over 4 hours in a 14 mm frame pointed at the celestial equator. Paths north of the equator curve toward north, paths south of it toward south, the equator is straight. Idealised model, physical scale, no magnification.

g.text: Untracked, 4 hours of star motion (14 mm, equator at frame centre)
● start ○ end (±2 h) · idealised model · physical scale
